placement: eight simultaneous body placements: head, sternum (T8), pelvis, left/right forearm, right upper arm, right thigh, right shank (Xsens MVN Link suit) plus head and both wrists (Project Aria headset + miniAria wristbands)
note: MODULE DESCRIPTOR ONLY. Deliberately NOT named metadata.json: data/scripts/curate/corpus_roots.py treats any directory containing a metadata.json as a dataset, so a metadata.json here would make 'nymeria' a phantom third dataset beside the two real ones. It also carries no scalar sampling_rate_hz, because this module produces TWO native rates -- the Xsens suit at 240 Hz and the decimated Aria IMUs at 200 Hz -- and build_grids.py reads one rate per dataset directory. convert.py copies the two templates above into data/pretraining/nymeria_xsens/metadata.json and data/pretraining/nymeria_aria/metadata.json, which is where corpus_roots.dataset_root() resolves them. Label-free: every session carries the reserved marker __unlabeled__; Phase-A self-supervision only, never a Phase-B evidence-bank source. Licence CC BY-NC 4.0 (non-commercial).
